source_caption_text:
#Blueface Gets SWATTED AGAIN‼️ This Is Now The 3rd Time Within The Last 2 1/2 Weeks 🚔😳

Blueface, whose real name is Johnathan Porter, is a Los Angeles rapper who became one of the most recognizable names in West Coast hip-hop during the late 2010s. Born January 20, 1997, he was a quarterback at Arleta High School and briefly played college football at Fayetteville State University before turning his attention to music. 

Blueface began gaining attention in 2018 with tracks such as “Deadlocs” and “Respect My Cryppin’.” His unusual, intentionally offbeat delivery helped his music go viral online and became a major part of his signature sound. His biggest mainstream breakthrough was “Thotiana,” which later received remixes featuring YG and Cardi B and peaked at No. 8 on the Billboard Hot 100. 

He followed his breakout with projects including Famous Cryp, Dirt Bag, and his 2020 debut studio album Find the Beat. Beyond music, Blueface has remained a major social-media personality and has also competed in boxing events. His combination of West Coast rap, viral moments, and a highly recognizable personality has kept him in the public spotlight well beyond his initial “Thotiana” breakout.
